UPCOMING EVENTS

This calendar lists all events offered through the Northampton Center for the Arts at 33 Hawley. Please visit our Classes calendar for classes and workshops! Events and programs offered by our building partners Northampton Open Media and Available Potential Enterprises (A.P.E. Ltd.) can be found on their websites.

  • Northampton Artisan Fair

    Saturday, November 28, 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM

    Free to attend!

    LEARN MORE

  • Think and Talk Tank

    First Monday of the month, 5:00-6:30 PM

    Free to attend!

    LEARN MORE

  • Passion Fridays

    Friday, December 4, 8:00 PM - midnight

    Cost: $15

    LEARN MORE

  • Chanukah Brunch Party with Myrtle Street Klezmer

    Sunday, December 6, 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM

    Cost: $10-25 suggested donation, no one turned away for lack of funds

    LEARN MORE

  • 30 Poems in November Reading & Celebration

    Sunday, December 6, 2:00 PM

    Free to attend!

    LEARN MORE

  • Friends of Northampton Trails Annual Meeting

    Tuesday, December 8, 6:30-8:30 PM

    Free to attend!

    LEARN MORE

  • Arts Night Out at 33

    Every Second Friday of the Month

    Next Date: Friday, December 11, 5:00-8:00 PM

    Free to attend!

    LEARN MORE

  • Slow Burn Speakeasy

    Friday, December 11, 8:00 PM

    Cost: $25/general admission, $40/VIP ticket

    LEARN MORE

  • Stars and Skulls Crafty Craft Fair

    Sunday, December 13, 11:00 AM - 4:00 PM

    Free to attend!

    LEARN MORE

  • Winter Market

    Sunday, December 20, 12:00-6:00 PM

    Free to attend!

    LEARN MORE

  • Pioneer Valley Jazz Shares: Tropos

    Thursday, January 21, 2027, 7:30-9:30 PM

    Cost: $20

    LEARN MORE

  • Hansel and Gretel Preview & Aria Concert

    Sunday, January 24, 2027, 3:00-4:00 PM

    Free to attend!

    LEARN MORE

  • Queer Prom

    Friday, February 12, 2027, 8:00-11:00 PM

    Cost: $15-30, sliding scale

    LEARN MORE

  • Flamenco Celebration of Jimi Hendrix with the Juanito Pascual Trio

    Sunday, February 21, 2027, 4:00 PM

    Cost: $18-43, sliding scale
